design: Fresh wording confirmation. Names reused from H744; wording tags old/new mean fresh template A/B in this experiment, not previous wording. Two narrative and two list templates locked before outputs. Frozen H746 original, new-wording, pooled-operation, identity and wording rank4 bases plus three random controls. Receiver-norm-preserving, separate q2/k2. Full factor2/native/zero controls. Single-edge original-value and absent Kevin/Brian downstream interventions. No fitting or candidate selection.
competence_gate: >=4 valid pairs, >=.75 both endpoint choices, >=.5 intended full-vocabulary top1; both operation cells must pass. All token-valid contexts retained. Exact source/final token and position matching required.
limitations: New wording relative to H742/H744/H746; reused names, not independent name confirmation. Several lexical cues change jointly. Surgical single edge, not global Q/K replacement. No natural reserved-test evaluation.
